scenarios.name: Copy and activates a view representation in an empty part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
the View representation branch is expanded with Primary active
the user chooses Copy from the Primary view representation context menu
a new view representation appears with its generated name selected for editing
the user enters "Capture View" and presses Enter
the new view representation has the name "Capture View"
